_about: Hand-checked additions to the automatic hospital matching. 'name' replaces the CMS display name (the CMS name is kept as 'aka' and stays searchable). 'tins' are tax IDs (TINs) to attach; each must exist in the plans with prices. 'why' says what the evidence is.
